limitations: Both arms use Qwen; this is a retrieval/workflow comparison, not a DeepSeek versus Qwen model benchmark.
Hybrid preserves baseline positives by construction; this guarantees nondecreasing positive-only recall, not precision.
Structured metadata can confirm pure time/location queries without a VLM; visual constraints still require image review.
Provider cache usage excludes probes, interrupted scope runs and responses not saved successfully.
No photos, original fids, captions, GPS coordinates or private service endpoints are published.
